# IMPACT MCP connector

> IMPACT gives Claude eight positioning tools for B2B teams: identify champions, map alternatives, pinpoint value, anchor a market segment, craft the message, translate it into execution, run a full positioning audit, and read the IMPACT framework itself. Every tool turns the details you give it into a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test.

- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Setup and tools: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/
- Privacy policy: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/privacy.html
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)

## Tools

- IMPACT Framework Guide (impact_get_framework): Get complete IMPACT framework methodology with phase-by-phase guidance
- Identify Champions (impact_identify_champions): Generate champion hypotheses from company/product context - no blanks, actionable insights
- Map Alternatives (impact_map_alternatives): Analyze competitive landscape and find positioning whitespace
- Pinpoint Value (impact_pinpoint_value): Generate value proposition with quantification and proof points
- Anchor Market (impact_anchor_market): Select beachhead market with scoring and TAM/SAM/SOM framework
- Craft Message (impact_craft_message): Build positioning statement and message hierarchy with variations
- Translate Execution (impact_translate_execution): Adapt positioning for specific channels and touchpoints
- IMPACT Full Audit (impact_full_audit): Complete positioning audit with scoring and recommendations

## Questions and answers

### What is IMPACT?

IMPACT gives Claude eight positioning tools for B2B teams: identify champions, map alternatives, pinpoint value, anchor a market segment, craft the message, translate it into execution, run a full positioning audit, and read the IMPACT framework itself. Every tool turns the details you give it into a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test.

### How do I connect IMPACT to Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector. Name it IMPACT, paste the server URL https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp, choose no sign-in and select Add. In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http impact https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp

### Does IMPACT need an account, and what does it cost?

No account or sign-in is needed, and there is no charge. The server is public and every tool is read-only.

### Which tools does IMPACT include?

8 tools: IMPACT Framework Guide, Identify Champions, Map Alternatives, Pinpoint Value, Anchor Market, Craft Message, Translate Execution, IMPACT Full Audit.

### What data does IMPACT keep?

None. Each call is answered from the inputs you give it, and the server stores and logs nothing. Netlify, the host, keeps its own request logs. See the privacy policy.

### Can I run IMPACT on my own computer?

Yes. Run npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp to use the same tools locally over stdio; nothing is sent to us.

### Who built IMPACT?

Shashwat Ghosh, founder of Helix GTM Consulting, a GTM Alpha consultant, AI GTM expert and fractional CMO with 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience.
